compose.title: Conversion funnel — visit → renew (animated cascade)
compose.description: Each stage's bar animates its width from 0 to its final size, staggered top-to-bottom. After each bar lands, its count + conversion % label fades in.

textMark.text: Stages cascade in top-to-bottom; conversion % labels follow each bar.
